items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That happened to me with a guy named Sol Yaged. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: Oh he was having a ball. He was wonderful. He wouldn’t let me go. He’d hold on to my — you know even though he was blind he’d hold me, “We’re not over yet, not done yet, we’ve got to talk some more.”
That happened to me with a guy named Sol Yaged.
